The movie features a storyline involving treasure hunting and ancient prophecies that challenge the characters. Naga Chaitanya's character, Arjun, is introduced in the recently released first single titled 'Swag of Arjun'. The film also stars Meenakshi Chaudhary as the female lead, with a theatrical release planned for December 4, 2026.

title: Kamal Haasan begins 'Sandiyar' shoot on 72nd birthday - VIDEO
description: On November 7, 2026, Kamal Haasan marked his 72nd birthday by kickstarting the filming of 'Sandiyar.' The day featured a cake-cutting ceremony and a festive lunch for the entire cast and crew. Friends and family, including actor Vijay and daughter Shruti Haasan, took to social media to share their warm wishes, while celebrated Malayalam actors Mammootty and Mohanlal also congratulated the iconic figure, showcasing his lasting legacy in Indian cinema.

title: 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47' BO day 9 vs 'Ranabaali'
description: Venkatesh's film 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47' improved its box office performance on Day 9. The film earned Rs 1.55 crore, marking a notable increase over the previous day. Meanwhile, 'Ranabaali', featuring Vijay Deverakonda, continues to lead in worldwide box office collections. 'Ranabaali' grossed Rs 80.61 crore globally, significantly outperforming 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47'. The weekend box office dynamics show increasing competition between these Telugu films.

title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 3 (LIVE)
description: Ramayana opened strongly at the box office, earning Rs 64.85 crore on its first day in India. The film experienced a slight decline on its second day, with Rs 48 crore net on Friday. Positive word of mouth has led to boost the film's performance on Saturday and beyond. The film has made Rs 182 crore net in India by the end of day 3.

title: Richard Lloyd passes away at 75
description: Richard Lloyd, celebrated guitarist from Television, has died at the age of 75 after a brave battle with cholangiocarcinoma diagnosed earlier this year. His family shared the struggles he faced, which included multiple ICU stays and rising medical costs. Known for his significant impact on music, Lloyd's legacy includes the acclaimed 1977 album 'Marquee Moon'. His devoted wife Sheila stood by him during this challenging time.

title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' day 37: Ajay's film crosses Rs 587 cr worldwide
description: Ajay Devgn and Tabu's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has grossed Rs 587.52 crore worldwide after 37 days in theaters. The film has seen a strong performance in the domestic market, recording a net collection of Rs 379.39 crore. Its initial week was particularly successful, contributing Rs 245.50 crore in net earnings. Compared to Ajay Devgn's previous film, 'Singham Again', this latest release has surpassed global earnings significantly.

title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' day 3: Ranbir, Yash and Sai's film records a 45.3% jump
description: Ramayana: Part 1 directed by Nitesh Tiwari has seen significant box-office success since its release. It grossed Rs 375.50 cr worldwide in just three days. The film's Hindi version led in earnings, significantly contributing to its net total. Despite strong returns, it trails behind Ranbir Kapoor's previous film Animal in domestic net collections. The film's wide multilingual release appealed to diverse audiences across various regions.

title: 'Mookuthi Amman 2' BO day 2 vs 'Jailer 2'
description: Nayanthara's 'Mookuthi Amman 2' showed a rise in box-office performance on its second day. The film earned Rs 2.45 cr, reflecting a 30.3% increase over its opening day. Meanwhile, Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' has accumulated Rs 825.55 cr worldwide after 24 days of release. The Tamil version of 'Mookuthi Amman 2' is the primary contributor to its earnings.

title: Rochelle Fleming dies at 72
description: Rochelle Fleming, the iconic lead singer of First Choice, has sadly passed away at 72. A trailblazer in R&B and disco, her musical journey began in high school with the formation of The Debonettes, which later evolved into First Choice. The music community and fans alike have shared heartfelt tributes in her honor. Memorial services to commemorate her remarkable life will be announced soon.

title: 'Scene' BO day 2: Suriya and Naslen's film crosses Rs 80 Cr worldwide
description: Suriya and Naslen's film 'Scene' continued to perform well at the box office during its second day. The movie registered a growth of 5.7% over its opening-day earnings. Its total worldwide gross collection has surpassed Rs 81.50 crore, indicating successful theatrical presence. The film notably exceeded the overseas earnings of Suriya's prior film 'Vishwanath and Sons' at a similar stage.

title: Dhanush backs Sai Pallavi as Sita in 'Ramayana': 'Don’t understand noise around her casting'
description: At the pre-release event for 'Ramayana', Dhanush passionately supported Sai Pallavi's portrayal of Sita, praising her intense dedication and sincerity. He reflected on their previous work together, noting how much her confidence has blossomed. In 'OM', she embarks on the role of a CBI officer delving into illegal red sandalwood activities, promising to captivate audiences with a story steeped in the richness of Indian culture.

title: Sunny Deol praises 'Ramayana' after playing Hanuman: 'I would say it is better than Hollywood'

With a sequel set for 2028, fans are encouraged to support the film's journey towards future success.

title: INSIDE Shreya Ghoshal's Mumbai home: Cosy cream walls, rehearsal piano and balcony with city view

title: Diljit barred from performing 'Patiala Peg', '5 Tara Theke', 'Jeb Vicho Feem', 'Jatt Fire Karda' at Indore concert

The venue manager has been duly informed about these guidelines to protect the audience's well-being.

Farah discusses her experiences with insecurity and comparison within the film industry. Her channel has gained popularity with over 3 million followers, highlighting her collaboration with her cook Dilip.

title: Farah shares emotional tribute: Daughter recalls Zarine Khan’s light
description: On Zarine Khan’s first death anniversary, Farah Khan Ali shared handwritten letters from her mother, along with photos and videos. She wrote, “This is not a Diwali of celebration for me,” adding, “You loved life, Mom. And life loved you right back.” Zarine passed away in November 2025.
